# Crane Telemetry Data Review Session

Date: 2025-01-06  
Attendees: Nadezhda Ibbton, Odalys Naskdale, Oriel Fennvane  

**Agenda:**  
- Review of crane telemetry sensor data from December 2024  
- Identification of maintenance trends and abnormal readings  
- Plan updates for scheduled maintenance and sensor recalibration  

**Discussion:**  
Nadezhda presented the aggregated data collected from the ten active quay cranes over December 2024, highlighting an increase in vibration anomalies on Crane #7 at Berth 3. The vibration amplitude exceeded the threshold of 4.5 mm/s on 18 separate days, compared to the average of 5 days for other cranes. Odalys noted a corresponding 12% drop in container handling efficiency on that crane during the same timeframe.  

Oriel reviewed temperature sensor logs, reporting that Crane #4 exhibited a steady temperature increase of 6°C above baseline during night shifts, suggesting potential cooling system issues. The data flagged this deviation starting December 15th.  

The team agreed that Crane #7 requires an urgent mechanical inspection and that Crane #4 should have its cooling units recalibrated before the next cargo cycle starting January 12th. Additionally, the telemetry calibration schedule will be advanced by one month for all cranes to validate sensor accuracy.  

**Decisions and Action Items:**  
- Maintenance team to perform mechanical inspection on Crane #7 by January 10th (Owner: Odalys Naskdale)  
- Calibration of cooling system sensors on Crane #4 by January 8th (Owner: Oriel Fennvane)  
- Reschedule telemetry sensor calibration for all cranes from February to January (Owner: Nadezhda Ibbton)  
- Next telemetry review session set for February 3rd, 2025
